title: Update Corp Card manual selection
summary: Updates corporate card manual selection in the Expense Agent app. Adds card selection, expense matching and card liability codeunits, a card lookup page, a card liability transfer page, a corporate cards API page and report card queries, and changes expense, expense report and posting objects, with new and updated tests.
key_points: New Expense Source enum and corporate card expense match interface with an implementing codeunit
New card selection and card liability management codeunits, plus card lookup and card liability transfer pages
New Expense Corporate Cards API page and a new Expense Capability enum value
New queries for report and posted report card displays and posted card transactions
Expense, expense report line and posting codeunits modified, with new liability tests and expanded posting tests
